newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures edge off late, still end higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures edge off late, still end higher.

text.p: May 14 - U.S. debt futures edged off late, still ended higher. Traders said futures dipped late on liquidation as dollar weakened vs yen after market talk that influential consulting firm said U.S. would support stronger yen. Market on edge about Thursday's April CPI, seen up 0.1 pct, core up 0.2 pct. Some said T-bond futures chart still looks supportive.
